newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.17 up at 41.28 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday amid profit-taking in the dollar that rose sharply on Wednesday, dealer said.
"The rupee will fall again as dollar buyers will soon be in the market," one dealer said. Profit-taking in the dollar started after the rupee plunged 0.25 on Wednesday.

The State Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 3.50 percent compared to Wednesday's close at 4.0. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
